title: AI Solutions Engineer banne ke liye 3 projects
content:
Certificate se job nahi milti. PROJECTS se milti hai.
Agar aap AI Solutions Engineer banna chahte ho, toh ye teen projects banao.

Pehle samjho company kya dekhti hai.
They don't want someone who only knows AI words.
They want someone who can take a messy business problem and ship a working solution.
Aur ye prove karne ka sabse simple tarika hai... portfolio.

Project ONE... documents se jawab dene wala assistant.
PDFs upload karo, sawaal poocho, aur jawab ke saath source dikhao.
Sources are important.
Bina source ke business AI pe bharosa nahi karta.
Isse aap retrieval, embeddings aur evaluation... sab seekhte ho.
These are the exact skills most AI products are built on today.

Par sirf chatbot banane se aap alag nahi dikhoge.

Project TWO... ek agent jo ek real workflow complete kare.
Maan lo ek lead form aata hai.
Agent lead ko qualify kare, CRM mein entry kare, aur team ko message bheje.
Now you are not showing AI. You are showing business value.

Project THREE... wahi cheez SAFELY ship karo.
Logs, testing, human approval, aur ek simple dashboard.
Interviews often come back to one question: what happens when the AI is wrong?
Jiske paas iska jawab hai, wo baaki candidates se aage hai.

Ab sabse important part.
Har project ka public README likho.
Kya problem thi, kaise solve kiya, aur kahan abhi bhi fail hota hai.
Honest limitations likhna weakness nahi hai.
It shows maturity.
Interviewer ko pata chalta hai ki aap system ko samajhte ho, sirf demo nahi.
Aur clients ko bhi yahi chahiye... honesty.

Aur har project pe ek chhota demo video banao.
Recruiters ke paas time kam hota hai.
A two minute demo says more than a long resume.
Teen projects, teen READMEs, teen videos... bas.
Main bhi is mahine yahi build in public kar raha hoon.
Ye ek mahine ka kaam hai, aur ye aapki poori profile badal sakta hai.

Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
